title: PISG: Constraint-Aligned Signal Amplification for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.19768v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion-based solvers have become a prominent approach to neural combinatorial optimization. At inference time, they assign each decision variable a prediction score. A greedy decoder ranks candidates by these scores and checks hard constraints to ensure feasibility. Top-ranked candidates should be both promising and jointly feasible, making prediction-constraint alignment critical. When this alignment is weak, greedy decoding skips constraint-violating candidates and falls back to lower-ranked alternatives, degrading solution quality. Existing test-time methods improve search, sampling, or decoding, but do not directly strengthen this alignment before decoding. We observe that trained denoisers already carry constraint-aligned structural signals. translated_title: PISG：面向基于扩散模型的组合优化的约束对齐信号放大
translated_abstract: 基于扩散的求解器已成为神经组合优化领域的一种主流方法。在推理阶段，它们为每个决策变量分配一个预测分数，贪心解码器根据这些分数对候选方案进行排序，并检查硬约束以确保可行性。排名靠前的候选方案应当既具有前景又同时满足约束条件，因此预测-约束对齐至关重要。当这种对齐较弱时，贪心解码会跳过违反约束的候选方案，转而选择排名较低的备选方案，从而降低解的质量。现有的测试时方法改进了搜索、采样或解码，但没有在解码之前直接增强这种对齐。我们观察到，训练好的去噪器已经携带了与约束对齐的结构信号。基于这一观察，我们提出了扰动实例-结构引导，这是一种无需训练的方法，可在测试时放大这些信号。在每个去噪步骤中，PISG 构建（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的测试时方法 PISG，通过放大扩散模型去噪器中固有的约束对齐结构信号，在解码前增强预测分数与约束可行性的对齐，从而提升基于扩散的组合优化的求解质量。
en_tdlr: PISG is a training-free test-time method that amplifies constraint-aligned structural signals already embedded in trained denoisers at each denoising step, strengthening prediction-constraint alignment before decoding to improve solution quality in diffusion-based combinatorial optimization.
